description: This file defines a function named cost_calculator that computes the cost associated with image generation using a specific model in Azure AI. It interacts with the litellm library to retrieve model information and processes an ImageResponse object to determine the number of images generated for cost calculation.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: Any, )
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of generating images based on the model info and image response provided.
